notes: The page-specific legibility is generally good despite light, sometimes very compressed handwriting. The raised qualifier, the two cancellations and the crowded first group expression require localized uncertainty. Principal lines 1–6 describe the written multimarquage data, including n_i, the sous-...torseur inclusion, s_i and the displayed product; the qualifier is not expanded into an inferred construction. Lines 7–14 name the groupe de Teichmüller multimarqué, state the natural placement in SRT(X), describe the choice with its written raised zero, and write the subgroup product and final factor sentence. These source statements are transcribed, not proved or repaired. C is closer to the visible later ST spellings, raised zero and order of the final prose. H preserves many agreed words but adds stars at the later ST occurrences, omits the choice's zero and marginal numeral, and separates and duplicates the final Z^I in its rearrangement. The two witnesses' typographic displays and roman/bold/blackboard fonts are not counted as independent wording errors. H's emphasis on multimarquage has no separate source underline; the plain word is retained. H's explanatory notes and the appended section heading are editorial material absent from the handwritten leaf and are excluded from the source transcription. The entire scan and both pre-made halves were each read once, and all twelve saved crops were visually inspected. The existing qualifier crop was revisited to narrow its alternatives, without creating another crop. Every body baseline, agreed word, formula, insertion and cancellation was checked. No OCR, external research, TeX compilation or mathematical proof checking was used.

Z and the lowered n_i are legible, while the intervening steep stroke retains a slash/grouping doubt. The first cancellation covers both words after the first inclusion, ending before the abbreviation; les groupes and de groupe remain explicit alternatives. All these states are separately inventoried and covered by localized neutral second boxes.
legibility: The body is generally legible. The raised qualifier, both cancellations and the compact first group expression have obscured or merged strokes and retain explicit doubts. C follows the later ST spellings, the chosen point’s raised zero and final prose order more closely; H adds lower stars to those later groups and rearranges the last inclusion. The plain words multimarquage and multimarqué, wedge-shaped exponents, visible abbreviations and lower marginal 3 are retained from the ink.
root_adjudication: Main reader inspected the full source and all twelve saved crops. The raised Z and low n_i are visible, but the steep stroke before n does not securely distinguish a slash from a detached initial stroke. Both alternatives remain. Multimarqué is resolved from its exposed letter sequence. The initial group’s crowded lower mark and retraced X remain doubtful, independently of the clear later ST occurrences. The i.e crop ends in a hooked e followed by blank paper, with no additional terminal point. The dot beside the product’s terminal index remains an unresolved pen/punctuation issue in the doubts record; no extra stop is supplied.
